fields.title: A field guide to accessible color contrast
fields.description: Practical rules for picking text and background colors that stay readable for everyone, with a walkthrough of the WCAG contrast math and the tools that automate it.

fields.title: Designing empty states that do real work
fields.description: An empty screen is not a failure, it is onboarding. How to use the first-run state to teach the interface, set expectations and invite the next action.

fields.title: The quiet comeback of the serif in UI
fields.description: Serif typefaces are showing up in product interfaces again. What changed in rendering, and where a serif helps rather than distracts.

fields.title: Django 6.0: what actually changed
fields.description: A tour of the release notes with an eye on upgrades: template partials, background tasks conventions, and the deprecations you should clear before they bite.

fields.title: Full-text search in Postgres without the pain
fields.description: When trigram similarity beats LIKE, how to index it properly, and the threshold values that keep typo tolerance from turning into noise.

fields.title: Modern CSS layout patterns worth keeping
fields.description: Container queries, subgrid and logical properties have quietly replaced a drawer full of layout hacks. A reference of the patterns that survived.

fields.title: Tests that pay for themselves
fields.description: A pragmatic split between unit, integration and smoke tests for a Django project, and why testing the admin is often a waste of time.

fields.title: Serving WebP and AVIF without a CDN
fields.description: How far you can get with Django, WhiteNoise and a build step: content negotiation, cache headers, and the fallback chain for older browsers.

fields.title: Shipping smaller: the case against the roadmap
fields.description: Roadmaps describe intentions, not outcomes. What happens when a product team replaces the twelve-month plan with a single bet and a weekly review.

fields.title: Interviewing users when nobody has time
fields.description: Five lightweight research formats that fit inside a normal sprint, from hallway testing to a two-question exit survey.

fields.title: Metrics that survive a reorganisation
fields.description: Why most dashboards rot within a quarter, and a small set of definitions that keep product metrics comparable across teams and time.

fields.title: The staff engineer's path
fields.description: Notes from a book on senior individual contributors: how the job changes, what gets measured, and the traps of becoming a decision bottleneck.

fields.title: Deep work in a notification-shaped world
fields.description: A short essay on attention residue and the practical scheduling tricks that make two uninterrupted hours possible again.

fields.title: Reading code like literature
fields.description: On building a habit of reading other people's source code for pleasure and pattern recognition, with a starter list of well-written projects.

fields.title: A compose file for every side project
fields.description: The minimal Docker Compose setup for Postgres and Redis in development: healthchecks, named volumes, and binding to localhost only.

fields.title: uv, ruff and the new Python toolchain
fields.description: Replacing pip, pip-tools, virtualenv and flake8 with two fast binaries, and what to keep in CI so the switch stays boring.

fields.title: pgAdmin is not a database client
fields.description: The case for psql and a handful of scripts over a GUI: reproducible queries, readable diffs, and faster onboarding for new team members.

fields.title: Image optimisation as a deployment step
fields.description: Converting uploads to WebP at save time keeps templates simple, but it has consequences for storage and migrations. A look at the trade-offs.

fields.title: Django 6.1 enters beta with async ORM improvements
fields.description: The first beta ships with broader async support in the ORM, a reworked template engine cache and a long list of deprecations to plan for.

fields.title: Interop 2026 wraps up: what landed in every browser
fields.description: Anchor positioning, view transitions and the remaining :has() edge cases are now consistent across engines. A short tour of what you can ship today.

fields.title: PostgreSQL 19 release candidate is out
fields.description: Faster planning for partitioned tables, incremental sort everywhere and a new built-in UUIDv7 function headline the release candidate.

fields.title: Variable fonts arrive in default UI kits
fields.description: What the change means for interface typography, and what it leaves untouched.
